prompt.project_info: Raw high-quality vertical smartphone portrait in a dimly lit luxury bedroom with a classical illuminated relief sculpture.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long straight red hair, deep brown eyes, defined brows, natural skin texture and relaxed thoughtful expression, wearing a sheer black patterned full-body catsuit with leopard or snakeskin motif and criss-cross lace-up leg detail.
prompt.composition_elements: Direct eye-level 9:16 full-body shot centered on a large bed. Sit upright on a slightly wrinkled white duvet with legs extended toward lens, bare feet in immediate foreground with glossy black polish, right index finger resting lightly near chin and left arm relaxed. Preserve the supplied catsuit and bed composition.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct smartphone-style flash creates distinct shadows and sharp outfit detail, combined with warm bedside lamp and illuminated beige classical relief sculpture for raw moody high-end atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end smartphone, 9:16, high contrast, realistic colors, slight natural grain, sharp face, catsuit lace-up pattern, feet and room textures.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a raw high-quality vertical smartphone portrait in a dimly lit luxury bedroom of one original approved adult woman with long straight red hair, deep brown eyes, defined brows, natural skin texture and a relaxed thoughtful expression. She wears a sheer black patterned full-body catsuit with leopard or snakeskin motif and criss-cross lace-up design down the legs. Use a direct eye-level 9:16 full-body shot centered on a large bed with crisp slightly wrinkled white bedding. She sits upright with legs extended toward the lens, bare feet in the immediate foreground with glossy black nail polish, right index finger resting lightly near the chin and left arm relaxed. Behind her, show a massive illuminated beige classical relief sculpture and a small bedside lamp with dark shade against textured stone wall. Use direct smartphone-style flash with distinct shadows, warm lamp and sculpture backlight, high contrast, realistic colors, slight natural grain and sharp detail on face, catsuit, feet and room textures.
